description: Design FMEA / ISO 14971 risk analysis (BME Design Section 8.9). Risk = probability x severity. Severity scale: Table 8.3 (1 Negligible, 3 Minor, 5 Serious, 9 Critical, 10 Catastrophic). Probability levels and acceptability regions: Figure 8.13 (Frequent, Likely, Occasional, Remote, Unlikely). Probabilities BEFORE control are estimated from verification measurements where one exists (evidence field), otherwise by design-team judgement (marked 'judgement'), as the book allows for academic projects. 'planned' controls are not yet implemented and are not counted as verified.

acceptability.note: Regions reconstructed from BME Design Figure 8.13 (U = unacceptable, A = ALARP, B = broadly acceptable). Columns: Negligible, Minor, Serious, Critical, Catastrophic.

risks.failure_mode: PPG drop-out (sensor off / motion) passes the Version 5 gate because the gate checks data after interpolation
risks.effect: Forecast built from interpolated, fabricated waveform; false reassurance or false alarm
risks.evidence_before: Version 5 alone handled only 24% of 40% PPG drop-out windows (quality_gate_before_rc07.csv)
controls: RC-07 raw-signal pre-check before interpolation (abstain if PPG > 30% missing; drop ECG/ABP channel if > 30% missing)
SIGNAL CHECK technical alarm, never a physiological alert, when abstaining
risks.evidence_after: 100% of 595 corrupted windows handled; 0 physiological alerts from abstained windows (quality_gate.csv)

risks.failure_mode: Version 5 rejects genuine arterial pressure in profound shock (MAP < 40 or DBP < 20 treated as artefact) and silently falls back to the less accurate ECG + PPG regime
risks.effect: Forecast jumps upward (e.g. 68 vs true 42 mmHg); CRITICAL alert downgraded to WATCH during the most dangerous period
risks.evidence_before: Under-alert in 53% of true MAP < 55 time; ABP rejected 54% (90 shock patients, Version 5 baseline)
controls: RC-09 shock-aware ABP check: reject only true artefacts (flat line, steps, zero pulse pressure, impossible values)
RC-10 measured-pressure floor: alert level never below what the measured arterial MAP itself indicates
RC-08 fail-safe hold: a lower-confidence estimate can never de-escalate an alert
risks.evidence_after: Under-alert 0.18% (shock cohort) / 0.3% (all test patients); ABP rejected 1.2%; genuine-shock ABP retained 95%; damped/flush artefacts still rejected 100%

risks.failure_mode: Alert de-escalates when the higher-confidence channel is lost rather than when the patient improves
risks.evidence_before: 41 unsafe de-escalations in the shock cohort (Version 5 baseline)
controls: RC-08 fail-safe hold with 'held' indicator on screen
3-update de-escalation persistence with 2 mmHg hysteresis

risks.failure_mode: ECG + PPG estimate of MAP is biased and imprecise (no pressure reference)
risks.effect: Missed hypotension (false reassurance) or false alarms
controls: Confidence cap: low-confidence estimate can raise at most WATCH
Labelling: 'trend only - not for treatment decisions'
Domain-specific bias calibration
risks.evidence_after: Cap removes false alarms but under-alert during true MAP < 55 is 100%: the risk cannot be reduced to ALARP with the current model -> Concept B not selected (Section 8.9.2: 'the design must be abandoned' or redesigned)

risks.failure_mode: Frequent WATCH-level alerts on real patients
risks.effect: Alarm fatigue; a true alarm is ignored (Sendelbach & Funk 2013)
risks.evidence_before: 12.6 false alarm episodes per hour at any level on real data (5.5 for a conventional monitor); 3.3/h at DETERIORATING or above
controls: Persistence (2 updates) and hysteresis (implemented)
IEC 60601-1-8 priorities: WATCH = low priority, visual only (implemented in colour/shape coding)
PLANNED: make WATCH a non-alarming information signal and tune the WATCH threshold on validation data
risks.evidence_after: ALARP pending the planned control and usability validation; tracked as SPEC-04 FAIL

risks.failure_mode: Vasopressor and fluid given together; combined input channel cannot separate their effects
risks.effect: Response attributed to the wrong treatment
risks.evidence_before: Version 5 encodes all treatments in one channel
controls: Event-log driven tracker (clinician-confirmed events)
Confounding flag shown when treatments overlap
Status reports a trend only, never a recommendation
risks.evidence_after: 96% agreement with ground truth on unconfounded events (intervention_agreement.csv)

risks.failure_mode: Real-data fine-tuning eroded vascular-state estimates (within-patient correlation R 0.54, C 0.03)
risks.effect: Clinician over-interprets an unreliable resistance/compliance value
controls: Displayed as relative trends with an on-screen caveat
Not used by the alert logic
PLANNED: multi-task fine-tuning that preserves R/C
risks.evidence_after: ALARP for a research prototype; must be fixed before clinical use

risks.failure_mode: Software text drifts into recommending therapy
risks.effect: Device becomes prescriptive (changes regulatory class; automation bias)
controls: Outputs restricted to observations and trends
Automated wording scan of every alert reason and review narrative (static_checks.py, SPEC-14)

risks.failure_mode: Update latency exceeds the 1 s update period on bedside CPU hardware
controls: CPU latency verified (p95 175 ms)
Latency shown per update; clock shows playback position

risks.failure_mode: Calibration fitted on simulation does not transfer to real patients
risks.effect: Mis-calibrated uncertainty band and risk score
risks.evidence_before: Simulation bias -9.0 mmHg vs real -2.4 mmHg in the intervention regime (calibration.json)
controls: Domain-specific calibration fitted on VitalDB validation cases only
risks.evidence_after: Real MAE 5.6 -> 4.7 mmHg after calibration (held-out test cases)

risks.failure_mode: Report used as a real-time monitor
controls: Banner on every report: retrospective decision-support summary, not a diagnosis
No alarm colours in report header

risks.effect: Decisions made on another patient's data
controls: Recording title and source always shown in page header and report
Changing patient resets the session

risks.failure_mode: Unverified model weights loaded (wrong file, corrupted copy, or Version 5's silent fallback to the synthetic-only checkpoint)
risks.effect: All verification evidence is void; real-patient MAE of the synthetic-only model is ~5x worse
risks.evidence_before: Version 5 predictor falls back to physics-informed_model.pth if the fine-tuned file is missing (judgement)
controls: SHA-256 of the loaded checkpoint compared with the verified value at start-up; mismatch refuses to start
Checksum shown in the app header and stored in every result file
risks.evidence_after: Tested: correct checkpoint loads; wrong expected hash -> RuntimeError, server does not start
